REF: Exact native MethodHooks(m2),lambda4; PRIMARY local control, not historical Linux E03
L01: E03 plus native dispatch fusion minus M2 dispatch fusion. Synced identical dispatch anchor returns exact E03.
L02: First round exact E03, then L01. Because original loop synchronizes every model this is an algebraic negative control, not a new post-sync mathematical effect.
L03: E03 score, native aggregation for true BatchNorm affine keys only
L04: E03 score, native aggregation for classifier.* only
L05: E03 score, native aggregation for both BatchNorm affine and classifier keys
L06: E03 score; low physical capability IDs0-39 with negative cosine get intrinsic gate1; all other intrinsic gates unchanged
L07: E03 score; actual Full profile6 uploads get intrinsic gate1
L08: Native M2 scoring on all common keys except true BatchNorm affine keys; global upload weighting
L09: Mean of valid backbone(noBN) and classifier LOO cosines, equal weight; BN excluded; apply original risk after cosine fusion
L10: Common intersection; per sender slot median peer-slot cosine within each other physical client, then median across distinct peers; no same-physical slots in reference; no sample-count/norm weighting of medians
L11: Original slot-LOO reference, risk=clamp(2*max(0,-dot)/(deltaSquare+referenceSquare+1e-12),0,1), invalid reference neutral; native M2 weight normalization
failure: Keep logs/checkpoints; no automatic retry or parameter changes; wait for the other job in this batch then stop subsequent batches on failure
no_extensions: Exactly12 runs, no extra seed, tuning, Q, Memory or new combinations
